peer.rule: same class ({class}), market segment ({segment}) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer
peer.priceBand.above: Higher relative price than most peers
peer.priceBand.below: Lower relative price than most peers
yield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash.
yield.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
yield.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
yield.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.
yield.position.near: near the peer median (its range includes it)
income.geography: {planningArea} planning area (Master Plan 2019), not a postal district.
income.definition: Income is household employment income including employer CPF.
income.context: This describes the area, not buyers.
income.attribution: SingStat, General Household Survey 2025, table C020145 (resident households by planning area and monthly household employment income)
income.conditions: Employment income includes employer CPF and platform-worker CPF contributions
Figures are rounded to the nearest 100 and may not add up
Small cells should be read with caution
r2.profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
r2.price.entryNote: The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.
r2.price.sizeBand: Not available: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison; the size-matched price position applies.
r2.resale.proxy: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date
r2.resale.noWave: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.
r2.resale.pastWave: The first resale wave ended before the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.
r2.resale.settling: Settling: fewer than 12 months of resales after the first resale wave, so sustained activity is not yet measurable. Observed activity is shown.
r2.infra.schoolsMoe: MOE measures distance for school admission differently.
r2.infra.futureNotAssessed: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.
r2.infra.futureRule: Planned stations are facts from official LTA sources, with their status and target date. They carry no points.
r2.supply.share: New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.
r2.supply.unsold: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.
r2.supply.pipeline: Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.
r2.supply.quiet: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage.
r2.surrounding.definition: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.
r2.resale.waveHeadline: Initial resale-wave effect: {inWave} of the {total} resales in {period} came in the first 12 months of the resale wave ({wavePeriod}), so this figure is not yet a sustained rate; sustained activity remains settling. The wave start is based on the {basisLabel}.
r2.resale.waveHeadlineSustained: Initial resale-wave effect: {inWave} of the {total} resales in {period} came in the first 12 months of the resale wave ({wavePeriod}); the sustained rate is shown separately. The wave start is based on the {basisLabel}.
